predecessors.name: Kingdom of England
predecessors.text: 'It was held by the Scots until 1333'; then 'control passed back and forth between the two kingdoms until the English took it for the last time in 1346'

successors.name: Kingdom of England
successors.text: 'the island came under the feudal lordship of the English Crown in 1399'

ledger.x: 1346: the English take the Isle of Man for the last time.
1399: the Isle of Man comes under the feudal lordship of the English Crown.

wars.name: Struggle for the Isle of Man
wars.outcome: The island changed hands in 1313 (Scots, under Bruce), 1314 (English), 1317 (Scots, under Randolph), 1333 (Scots hold ends), and passed to the English 'for the last time in 1346'.

certainty.note: An island: the coast is its border.
